title: SyncHoldReceipt (v1)
description: Signed sync hold receipt (subject = signer — receipt-family): the relay's own record of which event ids it stores for an identity, with a digest of the held bytes and a redaction flag per event, the client's request nonce echoed, and — on a pull page — the seq range the page covers. Verified by verifySyncHoldReceipt in @motebit/crypto against the caller's pinned relay key. Spec: spec/sync-hold-receipt-v1.md.

relay_motebit_id.description: The relay's motebit id — the holder and the signer (subject = signer).

relay_public_key.description: The relay's Ed25519 public key, lowercase hex.

motebit_id.description: The identity whose events are held.

nonce.description: The client-supplied request nonce, echoed exactly. Always present: a receipt is issued only to a request carrying a usable nonce.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical entry exactly as the relay serves it from storage (without `seq`).

redacted.description: True when the held entry is in redacted form.

seq.description: The event's relay ingest sequence. Present on pull-page receipts only.

events.description: The events the relay holds among those the request concerned, in request order.

page.description: Present on pull-page receipts only: the seq range the page covers.

after_seq.description: The cursor the request asked from.

next_seq.description: The largest seq in the page, or `after_seq` when empty.

latest_seq.description: The largest seq the relay has ever assigned the identity.

suite.description: Cryptosuite (pinned literal — new suites arrive as new receipt versions).

signature.description: Ed25519 over the JCS-canonical receipt minus this field, base64url.
